why: Every Ruche package in this project must run from a tracked-only clean checkout with no dependency on any sibling task directory. This task therefore carries its OWN byte-identical copy of the certified instrumentation rather than reaching sideways into TASK-2026-09-02-SMC-HIGHRUNG-LAMBDA/support/. That predecessor copy IS tracked, so a cross-task path would work today, but it would make this package's correctness depend on a sibling task nobody is maintaining. Self-containment is cheaper than that coupling.
closure_method: Inherited verbatim from TASK-2026-09-01-SMCRUCHE-PACKFIX via TASK-2026-09-02-SMC-HIGHRUNG-LAMBDA, which computed it by ast.parse of instrumented.py, walking Import/ImportFrom nodes and following any resolving to a sibling module in the (untracked) SMCSTAT analysis directory. Result: no sibling imports at all. Re-verified here by sha256 identity with the predecessor bundle, which is the same claim by a stronger route: the file is the same bytes, so its closure is the same closure.
not_bundled_because_tracked: pps_qj (the production package, tracked in this repository)

files.note: Copied verbatim. NOT rewritten, NOT reformatted, NOT re-implemented. This is the exact file that produced every frozen ARM1/ARM2/ARM-A/ARM-B result and that TASK-2026-08-30-SMCSTAT validated bitwise against the production path. Its dtau_mult default is the certified 6.0, never the corpus 12.0. Identical sha256 to the predecessor bundle is the evidence that this campaign runs the SAME sampler as the ARM-B data it reuses.
